answer: Make each new identity pay in time it cannot buy back. Step 1: a newcomer registers its key and gets a seed, a flag on a knoll. Step 2: it runs a delay proof taking 15 minutes on one core - extra cores cannot help, each step needs the last. Step 3: verifiers check it in seconds, then it takes small paid jobs. Step 4: for 30 days it must renew daily; one missed day drops trust to its nadir. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 7,500 core-hours a month, about $300 rented, plus 30 days no money can compress. A sybil farm is a counterfeiter printing opals: every fake still needs a day in the kiln.
